in_hebrew.name: יָבֶשֶׁת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: from the Hebrew word 'yavash' meaning blue or bluish-green, derived from the root 'yabash' meaning to be wet or to be drenched.

in_greek.name: Ἆλκης
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'helkos' or 'halchos' meaning blue, green, or field. It could also be derived from 'helkos' meaning a pile or heap, possibly referring to a field or meadow.

in_latin.name: Campus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'campus' meaning a level piece of land or a field.
